item.observed: Saving telegram_api_id and telegram_api_hash does not change the credentials used for login
item.title: The operator cannot replace their wrong Telegram API ID and hash in the admin panel — login reads only server environment variables and settings silently discard the submitted fields

item.observed: Phone and 2FA password are not stored by PUT /settings or reloaded in a new session
item.title: The operator cannot save their corrected Telegram phone and 2FA password for future logins — settings excludes both fields and the form only holds transient inputs

item.observed: POST /api/public/telegram/resend-code and /telegram/verify-code return 404
item.title: Clients using the specified Telegram login endpoints cannot request or verify a code — the dispatcher implements only /sankmo-bot/send-code and /sankmo-bot/verify

item.observed: A failed first attempt is marked seen; polling will not retry that message
item.title: A temporary converter, bot or network failure permanently loses the affected source deal — the reader marks the message seen and advances its cursor before any conversion or post succeeds

item.observed: The same product can be posted again after the 5-minute default window
item.title: Followers receive the same product again after the repeat window — reader deduplication expires after the configurable 5–60 minutes instead of retaining a per-destination sent record

item.observed: One getChat failure aborts the cycle before the other channel is sent
item.title: A broken destination prevents deals reaching every other working channel — all destination getChat and claim operations share one rejecting Promise.all before any send begins

item.observed: Restart sets lastId to the newest source message and skips all earlier unseen messages
item.title: Deals posted during a restart or outage are silently missed — reader startup initializes each source cursor to its latest message instead of restoring a durable last-read cursor

item.observed: The initial two destination rows cannot be expanded to five or removed
item.title: The operator cannot add or remove reader destinations — the settings form renders only existing rows and provides no add or delete controls

item.observed: min_price='abc' is saved as 0, and two identical chats are both returned
item.title: Invalid prices are silently saved as zero and duplicate destination names remain — reader validation coerces invalid values and never deduplicates normalized chats

item.observed: Source status shows only a startup check mark and no last-read time
item.title: Operators cannot see which source has stopped being read — channel health records resolution at startup but never records each source's last read time or poll result

item.observed: A newly created destination has no id; its action URLs contain /destinations/undefined
item.title: Operators cannot test, edit, remove or select a newly added posting bot — destination creation never assigns the id required by every subsequent action

item.observed: Any Telegram chat sending /Radhe is enrolled without the one-time pairing code
item.title: Strangers can use the owner's affiliate conversion services and change the bot's reply style — the public /Radhe command enrolls arbitrary chats without administrator authorization

item.observed: Owner key-failure alerts are sent to every enrolled non-channel chat
item.title: Affiliate account and feed-health alerts reach strangers who enroll their chat — notifyOwner broadcasts to all converter chats rather than an authenticated owner

item.observed: A timed-out sendMessage can be sent again up to two times
item.title: Followers can receive duplicate deal posts after a Telegram timeout — the shared Telegram helper retries non-idempotent sendMessage calls when the first outcome is unknown

item.observed: Switching reader off sets connected=false even when the Telegram session remains saved
item.title: The operator sees their Telegram account as disconnected after switching off the reader — status uses the live reader connection instead of the persisted login

item.observed: Converter history shows only the newest 200 rows with no next page
item.title: Operators cannot find older converted links once history grows — the history endpoint caps results and the tab offers no pagination

item.observed: Converter History has no product/link filter, filtered count, or copy button
item.title: Operators cannot search history or copy an earlier conversion from its row — the history tab renders an unfiltered list of links without search or copy controls

item.observed: The caption editor has no preview of the saved template
item.title: Operators cannot preview the reader caption before saving — the settings form never renders a sample deal

item.observed: converter_logs sort by received_at has no {received_at:-1} index
item.title: Converter History slows as conversion logs accumulate — each refresh sorts the full unindexed converter_logs collection by received_at

item.observed: A timed-out fkrt.site URL remains a Flipkart link and is sent to the converter
item.title: Unresolved source affiliate short links can be reposted without identifying the product — cleanLink swallows redirect failures and the reader accepts the original fkrt.site URL as a product

item.observed: A source line 'Deal price: ₹5,000' produces no parsed price and misses Deltfetch
item.title: Valid expensive deals are omitted from the high-price channel and their posts lack prices — the reader recognizes only exact Price, Selling Price or Discounted Price line formats

item.observed: A rejected sendPhoto records failure instead of retrying the same caption as text
item.title: Photo-mode followers miss a deal when Telegram rejects its image — the reader has no sendMessage fallback after sendPhoto fails

item.observed: Conversion failures are written to converter_logs but never update reader last_error
item.title: The reader status hides failed conversions — the no-product and no-converted-link branches return after logging without recording last_error

item.observed: A post with one old and one new product includes both links in the destination caption
item.title: A channel receives a repeated product in a multi-link post — any fresh claim sends all converted products, including products already claimed for that destination

item.observed: Re-converting an existing published deal sets publication_status to draft
item.title: A live website deal disappears when the operator reconverts its link — saveConvertedDeal overwrites an existing published record with draft status and clears its publication timestamps

item.observed: A rejected key leaves the cleaned non-affiliate URL available to copy and share
item.title: An operator can unknowingly share a non-earning link after conversion fails — bulk conversion substitutes the cleaned URL and leaves copy and share actions enabled

item.observed: Polling fetches at most 3 messages and drops posts older than 3 minutes
item.title: Busy or briefly disconnected source channels lose eligible deals — the polling safety net reads only the latest three messages and discards messages over three minutes old

item.observed: A tick lasting over 8 seconds runs concurrently with the next scheduled tick
item.title: The reader starts overlapping source-read cycles when processing is slow — the eight-second interval launches tick without waiting for the previous cycle

item.observed: POST /auth/login accepts unlimited password attempts without a rate limit
item.title: The owner's admin panel and Telegram controls are exposed to unrestricted password guessing — the public login route has no attempt throttling or lockout

item.observed: The public image proxy follows redirects without validating the destination host
item.title: An unauthenticated visitor can make the server request internal network resources — /image-proxy checks only the initial URL and follows redirects without resolving and blocking private addresses

item.observed: imageProxy buffers the entire response before checking its 8 MB limit
item.title: Visitors can exhaust server memory and disrupt the site through the public image proxy — the 8 MB limit is checked only after the complete remote body is buffered

item.observed: Hourly deduplication deletes later reviewed deals solely by product, price and creation time
item.title: Reviewed and published deals can be permanently deleted by the automatic duplicate cleanup — it discards later records without preserving publication state or editorial work

item.observed: Failed affiliate conversion falls back to the clean link and can still be published and posted
item.title: The owner loses affiliate commissions when a key fails during normal scanning or reposting — conversion errors are swallowed and unconverted deals still go live and to Telegram

item.observed: An expired-code error refreshes status to code_sent=false and removes the input
item.title: The operator loses the code box when their Telegram code expires — the verification error reloads expired pending state and conditionally unmounts the input instead of keeping it open

item.observed: A deal already converting can still be sent after the reader is switched off
item.title: The operator can still get new channel posts after turning the reader off — stopping removes the timer but does not cancel or recheck in-flight posting jobs

item.observed: The Render deployment has no scheduler and starts the reader only on an API request
item.title: The enabled reader stops watching channels after the web service sleeps or restarts until somebody visits — no worker or scheduled wake-up is deployed and initialization depends on a request

item.observed: An admin token remains valid for up to 30 days after logout
item.title: A copied admin session continues to access Telegram settings after logout — sign-out only deletes browser storage and the server has no session revocation check

item.observed: A stopped reader reports sources=[] and user=null despite saved settings and session
item.title: The operator cannot see saved source channels or the Telegram user while the reader is off — status returns process-local startup defaults instead of reading stored configuration

item.observed: last_read, last_sent and last_error reset to null after a process restart
item.title: The operator loses the reader's last activity and failure history after a restart — status timestamps and errors exist only in process memory

item.observed: A getMessages error for the first source exits the entire poll loop
item.title: One inaccessible source prevents the reader's polling safety net from reading the remaining channels — the error handler wraps the whole loop instead of each source

item.observed: If Telegram logout fails, the session is removed locally but may remain authorized
item.title: The operator's Telegram session can remain usable after Disconnect reports success — logout errors are swallowed and the stored session is deleted without confirming Telegram revoked it

item.observed: Switching away from Affiliate Setup discards a partially typed Telegram code
item.title: The operator loses a partially entered Telegram code when changing admin tabs — the code box state belongs to a tab panel that unmounts and there is no cancel control

item.observed: Deleting the selected posting bot silently falls back to the converter bot
item.title: Reader posts use a different bot than the operator selected after that bot is removed — missing selected destinations silently fall back to the converter token

item.observed: No eligible destinations calls insertMany([]) and records a reader error
item.title: The operator sees a reader error for a correctly filtered low-price deal — the no-destination path attempts to insert an empty batch instead of recording a normal skip

item.observed: Review queue sorts deals by created_at without a {created_at:-1} index
item.title: The admin review queue slows as deals accumulate — loading the newest 500 sorts the deals collection without a created_at index

item.observed: The public list stops at 120 deals and searches only the first 1,000 sorted rows
item.title: Visitors cannot browse or find older matching published deals — the deals endpoint truncates results and searches a capped set without pagination

item.observed: A failed settings request leaves the Rules tab blank
item.title: Operators get a blank Rules tab when settings cannot load — the settings request has no error handler or retry state

item.observed: A failed history request is displayed as 'No links converted' or 'Nothing sent yet'
item.title: Operators mistake unavailable conversion and post history for empty history — both tabs initialize empty arrays and never handle failed loads

item.observed: A failed status poll after initial load leaves the last connected status on screen
item.title: The operator sees stale reader status as current when polling fails — the polling error is hidden after initial data has loaded

item.observed: A revoked Telegram session still displays 'Logged in' while its stored string exists
item.title: The operator is told Telegram is logged in after the account session is revoked — connection status checks only whether a session string is stored

item.observed: Repeated Add channel clicks issue multiple destination-creation requests
item.title: Operators can add duplicate Telegram channels and post deals multiple times — Add channel stays enabled during the request and the server has no uniqueness guard

item.observed: Rules settings accept giftcard_min=-1 and product_min=500
item.title: Operators can save impossible discount thresholds and miss or misclassify deals — the rules settings endpoint does not validate discount percentages

item.observed: Destination settings accept min_discount=-1 or 500 and arbitrary category arrays
item.title: A channel can silently miss or receive unintended deals — destination creation and editing do not validate discount range or allowed categories

item.observed: The destination delete button removes a channel immediately with no confirmation
item.title: An operator can accidentally remove a posting channel with no undo — the destination delete control calls DELETE directly

item.observed: Configured backend has no Telegram API ID/hash; admin settings cannot save replacements
item.title: The operator cannot replace their wrong Telegram API ID and hash or request a code — login reads only missing server environment variables and settings silently discard the submitted fields

item.observed: Two code requests can succeed seconds apart on opposite sides of a minute boundary
item.title: Rapid Telegram code resends can bypass the intended wait and risk a provider lockout — the throttle uses fixed calendar buckets instead of a rolling interval

item.observed: A source post without a recognized shop URL returns without a skip record
item.title: The operator cannot audit source posts skipped for missing links — the reader exits before writing a skip or error log

item.observed: One link sent to two destinations creates two rows in Converter History
item.title: Operators see the same conversion multiple times in history — the reader writes one converted-link row per destination and the history endpoint returns all of them

item.observed: A failed price-history request is shown as 'No price history found'
item.title: Shoppers mistake a price-history outage for a product with no history — the dialog converts every API error into an empty-data state

item.observed: A failed destinations request shows 'No channels yet'
item.title: Operators may think their posting channels have disappeared when the API is unavailable — the destination list has no loading or error state

item.observed: Sources list sorts by created_at without a {created_at:-1} index
item.title: The operator's source list slows as sources accumulate — every reload sorts the sources collection without a created_at index

item.observed: A cache-clear failure returns an error after the new affiliate settings have been written
item.title: An operator can see a failed settings save even though their affiliate keys were changed — the database update commits before converter cache invalidation can fail

item.observed: A failed import after inserting the seen key is skipped on the next scan
item.title: A temporary failure can permanently omit a source deal from the website and channels — the importer records it as seen before resolving and saving it

item.observed: GET /img/{id} serves cached images without checking whether the deal is published
item.title: An unpublished deal's saved image remains publicly accessible by its old URL — the image endpoint does not check publication status

item.observed: Copy shows success even when the clipboard fallback returns false
item.title: Operators can be told a deal was copied when nothing reached the clipboard — the fallback ignores the result of execCommand

item.observed: Products sharing the first 18 normalized title characters are treated as one item
item.title: Shoppers can be sent to a different product as the best price — price comparison matches only a short title prefix and can confuse variants with different storage or specifications
